G3056.definition: A word or expression of thought; also a saying, statement, speech, message, subject matter, or account. In John 1, the term is used of the Divine Word (Logos).

G2424.definition: Jesus. The same Greek name can also refer to Joshua or to other people named Jesus, depending on context.
